tbesh_html:
1) dwelling, habitation, refuge
1a) den, lair (of animals)
1b) dwelling-place (of God) (fig.)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: {an abode, of God (the Tabernacle or the Temple), men (their home) or animals (their lair); hence, a retreat (asylum)}
strongs_1890.derivation: or מְעֹנָה; feminine of H4583 (מָעוֹן), and meaning the same
